ideas.title: The Rise of Fraud in Minnesota: A Deep Dive
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent rise of fraud cases in Minnesota, including the $250M pilfering scheme and the misuse of Medicaid funds.
questions: What are the root causes of the rise in fraud cases?
How can these cases be prevented in the future?
ideas.insight: The recent cases of fraud in Minnesota highlight a need for greater oversight and regulation of non-profit organizations and Medicaid funds.
